bots.name: Crypto bot
bots.venue: Hyperliquid; Hyro Instant (Bybit API) — own-strategy bots confirmed by Hyro support

accounts.label: Hyro Instant
accounts.note: Hyro support confirmed (Discord ticket-11528): own bots/scripts allowed on Hyro Instant via Bybit or BloFin API; third-party bots, copy trading and signals are not. Trade-only key, withdrawals off, IP-locked, kept in .env. Rules: 5% max loss, 3% daily, 2% per trade, margin ≤25% and notional ≤2× initial, low caps ≤5% per position (40% of profit counts), payout ≤5% of initial.

strategies.name: S/R break
strategies.summary: Goes long when price breaks a volume-defined resistance level on 6-hour bars while open interest is rising.
rules: Enter long when the whole candle clears resistance and OI is expanding
Stop 3 ATR below entry, exit after 15 bars, no take-profit

evidence.note: Excess Sharpe over random-timing trades. Out-of-sample = 2023, never used to fit. Measured after fixing the stop-bar lookahead (as-built 2.09, fixed 1.42 absolute).

strategies.gate: Passed: kept its edge on 2023 data it was never fitted to.

strategies.name: OI rank
strategies.summary: Each rebalance, goes long the 5 coins with the biggest rise in open interest and short the 5 with the biggest fall.
rules: OI change ranked over 3, 5, 7, 10 and 14 days, then averaged

evidence.note: Excess Sharpe over 40 random books. Lost about 10% of its edge out of sample, the least of any sleeve tested.

strategies.gate: Passed on direction and stability; 12 months cannot reach t = 2 even for a real edge, so it stays at paper until more history confirms it.

strategies.name: Deep dip (BNF)
strategies.summary: Buys a coin after its daily close falls 20% or more below its 25-day average, sells the rebound.
rules: Long when the close is ≥20% below the 25-day SMA
Exit on a close back at the SMA, or after 10 days
No stop in the test (worst trade −58%), so size must be small

evidence.note: +3.76% per trade vs +0.57% for random entries on the same coin and hold (400 trades). Held on the 33 other coins: +2.82%, t 2.78. Edge is shrinking each year: 7.1% (2023), 6.1%, 2.8%, 1.2% (2026).

strategies.gate: Survivorship check on older data that includes coins that died (2019–2022), then paper trading.
strategies.blocker: Data only covers coins still listed today, which flatters dip-buying.

strategies.name: Candle book (7 sleeves)
strategies.summary: Seven candlestick-pattern sleeves. Built by the same process that produced a sleeve that turned out to be 90% lookahead, so it is being re-audited before any money goes in.
rules: Hammer 6h and 12h, Three White Soldiers 6h, Bullish 3-Line Strike 12h, Bearish Engulfing 6h, Hanging Man 6h, Tweezer Top 12h
strategies.gate: Stop-bar exit audit, then the 2023 holdout against random entry.

strategies.name: Aggressive opening
strategies.summary: Long coins where open interest and aggressive buying both rose over the last 3 days, hedged with a short of the whole basket.
rules: Daily: long every coin with 3-day OI change > 0 and 3-day net taker flow > 0
Equal-dollar short of the coin basket
strategies.gate: One run on 2019–2022 data only. Pass = t above 2, positive in 3 of 4 years, correlation under 0.6 with OI rank.
strategies.blocker: Needs OI history for 2019–2022 (CoinGlass) and Binance taker data pulled on the server.

strategies.name: Cross-asset trend
strategies.summary: Follows medium-term trends across gold, silver, oil, the S&P, the Nasdaq and bonds, sized so every market carries the same risk.
rules: Rules to be written down in full before the first test
Daily bars, each market sized to equal volatility
Long or short with the trend, no discretionary overrides
strategies.gate: Tested once on 20+ years of daily data, must beat random entry out of sample.
strategies.blocker: Needs daily price history, pulled on the server.
